session_sum_policy: Do not publish a single cross-source historical session total because some source families overlap monthly and YTD periods. Counts remain source/period scoped.

evidence_rule: Only source-observed charging session counts with usable site geography, period and provenance count toward the report's observed-session layer. AADT, inventory, energy-only demand series, modeled utilization and statewide aggregates do not.
